Evidence SQL:
-- 平均分查询
SELECT AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite) as avg_writing_score FROM schools sch JOIN satscores sat ON sch.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE (sch.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR sch.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01');
-- 学校明细查询
